scripts.lint: pnpm check:budgets && oxlint apps packages services tests tools docs/governance -c ./.oxlintrc.json --react-plugin
scripts.lint:audit: oxlint apps packages services tests tools docs/governance -c ./.oxlintrc.json --react-plugin --jsx-a11y-plugin --vitest-plugin --import-plugin
scripts.format: oxfmt apps packages services tests vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts --write --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.format:check: oxfmt apps packages services tests vitest.config.ts playwright.config.ts --check --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.assets:duplicates: awk -F, 'NR > 1 { if (seen[$3]++) { print "duplicate runtime asset hash: " $3 > "/dev/stderr"; failed=1 } } END { exit failed }' packages/content/assets/RUNTIME-ASSET-LEDGER.csv
scripts.assets:check: awk -F, 'NR > 1 { print $3 "  " $2 }' packages/content/assets/RUNTIME-ASSET-LEDGER.csv | shasum -a 256 -c - && pnpm assets:duplicates && pnpm assets:intake
scripts.docs:check: pnpm pro-gov doctor && pnpm doc-gov router-check && pnpm doc-gov check && pnpm doc-gov scan --check && pnpm doc-gov links && pnpm doc-gov audit && pnpm doc-gov doctor
scripts.cloud:check: pnpm governance:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm assets:check && pnpm content:fidelity && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify: pnpm content:fidelity && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
